name: Itsudemo Saimin - Itsudemo Anata wa Fukai Saimin Joutai ni Hairu
original_name: イツデモ催眠 イツデモ貴女は深い催眠状態に入る

A busty wife and her cheeky daughter visit a relaxation seminar, and end up getting hypnotized.

Enjoy seeing what unfolds as the hypnosis strengthens...

欣赏随着催眠的加强所发生的事情……
